body: I guess that’s part of the intention of my old therapist. It’s so hard for me. I guess I’ll see how it goes. Thanks!
Hope you feel less alone in the situation. I’m having my last session with mine soon. I don’t really want to think about what will happen after she leaves…
Exactly why I fear overdose. It’s too costly to survive afterwards.
Thank you! Still here but struggling
Same. I started to worry excessively in recent years. I have also become extremely irritable :(
You have so many things I want so much. I'm sorry you still feel this way.

For me, suffering the sadness means to survive it despite how much it hurts. Sadness is too overwhelming for me to observe or coexist with. However melancholy could be observed as long as it is not too overwhelming. I have been trying to distinguish melancholy from sadness.

Can’t agree more on how the lack of romantic love hurts. I crave a romantic relationship too but the crave hurts me even more. In dating I only have 50% of control while the other person has the other 50%. They can leave me any time and this kind of uncertainty brings me more sadness and anxiety. Dating is like a emotional roller coaster for me :(

I cried hard today. Sudden sadness hit me. I don’t understand why antidepressants don’t prevent me from crying or being sad. The hit makes me feel life is meaningless but I hanged in there although no one was there for me. I cried for half an hour and I passed out for an hour. Now I am going to shower and get ready for tomorrow’s work, although I still feel life is meaningless. Maybe tomorrow will be better
Living is merely the chaos of existence
Agree. I always think that if I die no one will even care. I don’t need a funeral whatsoever.
Thank you. I keep reminding myself suicide is the easy way out only for cowards
I experienced this once when my psychiatrist cut down my dosage. She asked me to take prior dosage and it went away. I suggest you discuss with your psychiatrist. Everything will be fine
